description: Get one error_events cluster by id (Error Observatory). Returns null when the id does not exist in the active project (INV-7 existence-leak parity). Read-only. Pass cross_project=true to look up across project boundaries (admin elevation).

cross_project.description: When true, looks up the row across all projects (admin elevation). Requires DARK_ERROR_OBS_OPERATOR_OVERRIDE=armed OR the caller's operator id in DARK_ERROR_OBS_ADMIN_OPERATORS.

operator.description: Caller operator id for cross-project allow-list check. Empty = resolve from the active session.

name: dark_memory_error_get
